密.meaning: High on a <part>mountain</part>, a hermit hides his diary in the <part>attic</part> of his hut, under nine locks and a sleeping bear. He never says a word about it, not even to his goats. His whole life runs on <kanji>secrecy</kanji>.
密.on: Once a year he <sound>meets</sound> the bear at midnight to swap new passwords.
密.kun: <sound>He</sound> keeps the very last key rolled up in an old <sound>so</sound>ck.

端.meaning: A wizard with a <part>beard</part> so long it trails behind him climbs a <part>mountain</part> and takes his <part>stand</part> on the very last rock, toes over nothing. The wind tugs his beard out over the drop like a flag. He's right on the <kanji>edge</kanji>.
端.on: Far below, a train roars out of a <sound>tun</sound>nel and toots at his dangling beard.
端.kun: '<sound>Ha</sound>!' he laughs, and holds up a <sound>shi</sound>eld against the wind.

途.meaning: A delivery robot carries <part>too much</part>: twelve pizzas, a sofa and a goat. It can't fit through the door, so it rolls down a <part>ramp</part>, round the duck pond, under the bridge and through the car wash. That's its usual <kanji>route</kanji>.
途.on: It steers by the <sound>to</sound>tem pole in the town square, turning left every time.
途.kun: 'Feed <sound>me</sound> <sound>chee</sound>se!' bleats the goat on top at every corner.

労.meaning: A strongman who is all <part>muscle</part> spends the whole night hauling crates up a hill for the town's <part>fireworks</part>. When they finally bang, he's asleep under a <part>blanket</part> on the grass, too tired to look. Nobody sees his hard <kanji>labor</kanji>.
労.on: Someone tucks a red <sound>ro</sound>se into his sleeping hand to say thanks.
労.kun: '<sound>Ea</sound>t this <sound>ta</sound>co,' says his mum, hugging him. '<sound>Wah</sound>, you worked so hard!'

兵.meaning: A spider in a thimble helmet guards the top of a <part>hill</part>, marching back and forth on all <part>eight</part> legs with a toothpick over its shoulder. Left, right, left, right, left, right, left, right. It's the bravest little <kanji>soldier</kanji>.
兵.on: At night it sleeps in a bale of <sound>hay</sound> with its helmet still on.
兵.kun: '<sound>Tsu</sound>!' it sneezes. '<sound>Wah</sound>!' It grabs a <sound>mo</sound>p to fight, but it's <sound>no</sound>t an enemy, just dust.

派.meaning: A river reaches the sea and splits into a <part>river delta</part>, a dozen streams fanning out. Each stream of <part>water drops</part> insists it's the real river, gives itself a name and a flag, and won't talk to the others. Every branch is its own <kanji>faction</kanji>.
派.on: Each stream builds its own little <sound>hu</sound>t on its bank and argues from the doorway.

散.meaning: Under the <part>moon</part>, <part>two</part> kids play football with a dandelion clock beside the pool. One leaps off the <part>diving board</part> and kicks it at the <part>goal</part>, the other swipes at it with a paper <part>fan</part>, and whoosh: a thousand fluffy seeds blow across the water. Every one of them flies off to <kanji>scatter</kanji>.
散.on: One seed lands right on top of a chocolate <sound>sun</sound>dae.
散.kun: The rest settle on a block of <sound>chee</sound>se, like fluffy white hair.

短.meaning: A magic bowl of <part>beans</part> eats anything that touches it. You poke it with a <part>dart</part>: crunch, munch, and the dart comes back a stub no longer than your fingernail. The beans burp. Your dart is now very <kanji>short</kanji>.
短.on: It's small enough to roll through a mouse's <sound>tun</sound>nel in the skirting board.
短.kun: 'Give <sound>me</sound> a <sound>jee</sound>p and a <sound>ca</sound>rp,' burps the bowl, 'and I'll make them tiny too.'
